title: The Internet Was Weeks Away From Disaster And No One Knew
summary: Veritasium tells the story of the XZ backdoor, how a patient attacker became maintainer and nearly compromised SSH on Linux systems. It also covers free software history and how encryption in SSH works.
why: Cited as an accessible, documentary-style account of the XZ backdoor in supply chain security discussions.

quote.text: which was just fascinating to watch/listen
